name: Coder and reviewer solve a task

steps.prompt: Solve {{ $.input.task }}. Coder: propose a solution and send it to reviewer. Reviewer: check it and send requested fixes to coder. Continue until reviewer can approve. Reviewer then calls finish with approved=true and a summary.

onError.prompt: The conversation failed. Independently solve and check this task: {{ $.input.task }}. Use the attached error and conversation as context. Return approval only if you can verify your solution.
